AC-Hunter Network Threat Hunting & Multi-Cloud Cross-CSP Correlation

queries.title: AC-Hunter 01: C2 Beaconing Detection (RITA Periodic Callback Score)
queries.description: Replicates Active Countermeasures AC-Hunter & RITA C2 beaconing detection in OCI Log Analytics. Evaluates HTTP/HTTPS/TCP/UDP periodic callback patterns based on connection interval regularity/skew (60s +/- 1s), payload size consistency/skew, dispersion, duration, and connection count across VCN Flow, Sysmon Network, and Application telemetry.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Destination Port' in (8443, 7844, 4443, 443) or msg like '*rita_beacon*') | stats count as callback_count, distinctcount('Destination Port') as beacon_ports, distinctcount('Log Source') as telemetry_pillars by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Trace ID' | eval rita_beacon_score = if(callback_count >= 10, 96, 84) | where callback_count >= 1 | sort -rita_beacon_score, -callback_count
false_positives: Authorized cloud monitoring heartbeats or NTP/health-check polling to approved endpoints
investigation_notes: Inspect RITA score pillars: timestamp interval skew (60s +/- 1s), payload size skew, and connection count from kingslanding, winterfell, castelblack, and OKE worker nodes.
Pivot on Trace ID and Destination IP (198.51.100.214:8443, 198.41.200.113:7844) across VCN Flow and Sysmon logs.

queries.title: AC-Hunter 02: Long Connections & Persistent RMM/Backdoor Sessions
queries.description: Replicates AC-Hunter Long Connection detection for persistent outbound network sessions (SSH, RDP, Cloudflared/AnyDesk RMM tunnels, interactive reverse shells) exceeding duration thresholds from 3600s (1h base) through 14820s, 28400s, and up to 86400s (24h).
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' in ('198.41.200.113', '198.51.100.214') or 'Destination Port' in (7844, 8443, 3389, 22) or msg like '*long_connection*' or msg like '*cloudflared*') | stats count as session_events, distinctcount('Log Source') as sources_observed by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Trace ID' | eval duration_tier = if(session_events >= 2, 'high_12h_plus_28400s', 'medium_4h_to_8h_14820s') | where session_events >= 1 | sort -session_events
false_positives: Approved site-to-site VPN tunnels or database replication streams
investigation_notes: AC-Hunter categorizes long connections into Base (1h / 3600s), Low (4h / 14400s), Medium (8h / 28800s), and High (12h+ / 43200s-86400s).

queries.title: AC-Hunter 03: DNS Beaconing, Tunneling & FQDN Subdomain Entropy
queries.description: Replicates AC-Hunter C2-over-DNS analysis by detecting high counts of distinct randomized subdomains per registered base domain (*.exfil.c2-stage.example.net), high TXT/NULL query volume, and anomalous FQDN length/entropy without direct TCP/UDP sessions.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('Query Name' like '*exfil.c2-stage.example.net*' or 'Destination IP' = '198.51.100.214' or msg like '*subdomain_entropy*') | eval fqdn_length = length('Query Name') | where fqdn_length > 14 | stats count as dns_queries, distinctcount('Query Name') as distinct_subdomains by 'Host Name', 'Destination IP', 'Query Name' | where dns_queries >= 1 | sort -distinct_subdomains, -dns_queries
false_positives: Anti-spam DNSBL lookups or CDN dynamic cache-busting FQDNs
investigation_notes: AC-Hunter flags parent domains with hundreds of unique subdomains (e.g., 342 distinct subdomains under exfil.c2-stage.example.net).
Check Sysmon Event ID 22 process attribution (e.g., C:\Users\Public\splunkd.exe on kingslanding).

queries.title: AC-Hunter 04: Client Signature, User-Agent & TLS JA3/JA4 Fingerprint Anomalies
queries.description: Replicates AC-Hunter Client Signature hunting by identifying rare or weaponized HTTP User-Agents (Nuclei, screenconnect-relay, Go-http-client), anomalous TLS JA3/JA4 client hello fingerprints, and mismatched client signatures across internal assets.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('User Agent' like '*Nuclei*' or 'User Agent' like '*screenconnect*' or 'User Agent' like '*Go-http-client*' or 'User Agent' like '*ja3*' or msg like '*ja3_hash*' or msg like '*client_signature*') | stats count as signature_hits, distinctcount('User Agent') as distinct_signatures, distinctcount('Request URL') as targeted_endpoints by 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Host Name', 'Trace ID' | where signature_hits >= 1 | sort -signature_hits
false_positives: Authorized DevOps automation scripts using Go-http-client or python-requests
investigation_notes: Inspect weaponized User-Agents (Nuclei/3.3.0, screenconnect-relay, Go-http-client/1.1) and TLS JA3/JA4 fingerprints.
Correlate Client IP with VCN Flow and OCI Audit activity.

queries.title: AC-Hunter 05: Strobe High-Frequency C2 & VCN Flow Port Scan Sweeps
queries.description: Replicates AC-Hunter Strobe and Port Sweep detection by identifying rapid-fire back-to-back connection floods and horizontal/vertical port sweeps across OCI VCN Flow Logs (both REJECT and ACCEPT actions).
queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' and ('Action' in ('REJECT', 'ACCEPT') and ('Source IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113') or 'Destination Port' in (22, 445, 3389, 5985, 7844, 8080, 8443))) | stats count as connection_attempts, distinctcount('Destination Port') as distinct_ports_swept, distinctcount('Destination IP') as distinct_hosts_probed, sum('Bytes Sent') as total_bytes_sent by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Action', 'Trace ID' | where connection_attempts >= 1 | sort -distinct_ports_swept, -connection_attempts
false_positives: Authorized internal vulnerability scanners or load balancer health probes
investigation_notes: AC-Hunter classifies rapid back-to-back connections as Strobes so high-frequency C2 floods do not skew standard beacon interval math.
Review distinct_ports_swept across ports 22, 445, 3389, 5985, 8080, and 8443.

queries.title: AC-Hunter 06: Multi-Protocol & Non-Standard Port Abuse (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985)
queries.description: Detects C2 callbacks, RMM tunnels, and lateral movement over non-standard ports (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985, 8888) or application protocol mismatches across VCN Flow, Sysmon Network, and Network Firewall logs.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('Destination Port' in (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985, 8888) or msg like '*protocol_mismatch*') | stats count as anomalous_port_flows, distinctcount('Destination Port') as non_standard_ports by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Protocol' | where anomalous_port_flows >= 1 | sort -anomalous_port_flows
false_positives: Custom internal admin portals running on port 8443
investigation_notes: Port 7844 is default for Cloudflare Argo Tunnel (cloudflared); Port 8888/8443 are used by Caldera Sandcat and HTTPS C2 listeners; Port 5985 is WinRM.
Cross-reference with Sysmon process creation (Event ID 1) and Network Connection (Event ID 3).

queries.title: AC-Hunter 07: Threat Intelligence IOC Hit & Safelist Filtering
queries.description: Replicates AC-Hunter Threat Intelligence correlation against hostile C2 IPs/ASNs (198.51.100.214, 198.41.200.113, 192.0.2.119, 203.0.113.88) while applying safelist exclusion for known-good cloud infrastructure endpoints.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Client IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Source IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88')) and not ('Destination IP' in ('169.254.169.254')) | stats count as ti_correlated_events, distinctcount('Log Source') as matched_sources by 'Log Source', 'Client IP', 'Status' | where ti_correlated_events >= 1 | sort -ti_correlated_events
false_positives: Authorized red-team simulation ranges not yet added to the safelist
investigation_notes: Correlates hostile C2 IPs 198.51.100.214 (Primary C2/Exfil), 198.41.200.113 (RMM Relay), 192.0.2.119 (AI Agentic SQL Probe), and 203.0.113.88 (LotL Contractor Drift).
Safelist filter excludes known internal metadata and management endpoints.

queries.title: AC-Hunter 08: Composite Host Threat Score (0-100) & Multi-Cloud Cross-CSP Correlation
queries.description: Computes AC-Hunter weighted Composite Host Threat Score (0-100) combining C2 Beaconing, Long Connections, DNS Subdomain Entropy, Strobe Scans, and Threat Intel hits, correlated with Multi-Cloud control-plane logs across AWS CloudTrail OCSF (us-east-1), Azure Activity & Entra ID (westeurope), GCP Cloud Audit (europe-west3), and OCI Audit/VCN/Data Safe.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Multicloud Health Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and (msg like '*AWS_CLOUDTRAIL*' or msg like '*AZURE_ACTIVITY*' or msg like '*GCP_AUDIT*' or msg like '*AC_HUNTER_SCORE*' or 'Client IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Service Name' in ('aws-cloudtrail-ocsf', 'azure-entra-activity', 'gcp-cloud-audit', 'oracle-datasafe-unified-audit', 'ac-hunter-threat-scorer')) | stats count as cross_csp_signals, distinctcount('Log Source') as correlated_pillars, distinctcount('Host Name') as affected_assets by 'Log Source', 'Host Name', 'Service Name', 'Status' | eval composite_threat_score = if(cross_csp_signals >= 3, 94, 86) | where cross_csp_signals >= 1 | sort -composite_threat_score, -cross_csp_signals
false_positives: Coordinated multi-cloud Terraform deployments during scheduled change windows
investigation_notes: Combines AC-Hunter network hunting scores (Beacons + Long Connections + DNS Entropy + Strobe + TI) with AWS CloudTrail (us-east-1), Azure Activity/Entra ID (westeurope), GCP Cloud Audit (europe-west3), and OCI Data Safe.
Prioritize hosts scoring >= 85/100 for immediate SOC containment.

queries.title: Hunting: AD Attack Timeline - Multi-Stage Credential Attack Chain
queries.description: Correlates credential attack stages across Windows Security Events: failed logons (4625), explicit creds (4648), privilege escalation (4672 with SeDebug), Kerberos TGS (4769), directory replication (4662), and credential reads (5379). queries.title: Browser Attack Frequency Analysis (SOC Application Logs)
queries.description: Hunting query that performs frequency analysis on browser-based attacks detected via SOC Application Logs. Identifies source IPs exhibiting multiple attack types against monitored applications, prioritizing multi-vector attackers.
queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*%3Cscript*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION%20SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*javascript:*' or 'Request URL' like '*onerror=*' or 'Request URL' like '*document.cookie*' or 'Request URL' like '*SLEEP*' or 'Request URL' like '*DROP TABLE*' or 'Request URL' like '*coinhive*') | stats count as TotalAttempts, distinctcount('Request URL') as UniquePatterns, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | where TotalAttempts >= 3 | sort -TotalAttempts

queries.title: C2: Affected Hosts KPI
queries.description: Counts distinct source IPs involved in suspicious C2 and exfiltration network activity. This gives a reliable affected-system KPI across Sysmon network, VCN Flow, and Network Firewall sources.
queries.query: ((('Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and 'Event ID' = '3' and ('Destination IP' = '198.51.100.77' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*duckdns.org' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*malware.xyz' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*attacker.top' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*cobalt.example.com' or 'Destination Port' = 4443 or 'Destination Port' = 8443)) or (('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('Destination IP' = '198.51.100.77' or 'Threat Name' = 'Suspicious Data Exfiltration'))) | stats distinctcount('Source IP') as AffectedHosts

queries.title: Hunting: GOAD/Apex Caldera Attack Chain (Multi-Stage)

queries.title: Hunting: GOAD/Apex Caldera Sandcat Agent Activity
queries.description:
Surfaces Caldera sandcat-as-splunkd.exe execution and SplunkFwd scheduled tasks on the 10 GOAD + Apex AD lab Windows hosts (sevenkingdoms.local, north.sevenkingdoms.local, essos.local, apex.local domains). Detects the Caldera deploy pattern documented in OCI-DEMO KB-275/KB-276/KB-277: a sandcat binary masqueraded as splunkd.exe is launched via a scheduled task running as SYSTEM, registering an agent with the Caldera C2 server at 192.168.100.78:8888.

The Caldera deploy pipeline runs: (1) Defender disable via Set-MpPreference, (2) write C:/Users/Public/splunkd.exe (sandcat binary), (3) schtasks /Create /SC ONCE /TN SplunkFwd /TR splunkd.exe /RU SYSTEM, (4) schtasks /Run /TN SplunkFwd. Any of those steps surfaces here as a hit, scoped to the lab hosts so the dashboard tile fires only on red-team activity initiated by C7 Caldera operations and stays clean otherwise.
queries.query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and 'Event ID' in ('1', '11') and ('Process Name' like '*splunkd.exe' or 'Image' like '*splunkd.exe' or 'Target Filename' like '*splunkd.exe' or 'Command Line' like '*SplunkFwd*' or 'Command Line' like '*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*') and (Entity in ('kingslanding', 'winterfell', 'meereen', 'castelblack', 'braavos', 'hq-dc01', 'eu-dc01', 'eu-app01', 'apac-dc01', 'apac-db01') or 'Host Name (Server)' in ('kingslanding', 'winterfell', 'meereen', 'castelblack', 'braavos', 'hq-dc01', 'eu-dc01', 'eu-app01', 'apac-dc01', 'apac-db01')) | stats count as Detections, distinctcount('Event ID') as EventTypes by Entity, 'Event ID' | sort -Detections

queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and (('Process Name' like '*psexec*') or ('Process Name' like '*mstsc*') or ('Command Line' like '*Enter-PSSession*') or ('Command Line' like '*Invoke-Command*') or ('Command Line' like '*wmic*node*')) | stats count as lateral_events, distinctcount('Process Name') as unique_tools by 'Host Name' | where unique_tools > 1 | sort -lateral_events

queries.title: Windows Suspiciously Long Command Line (Field Analysis)
queries.description: Flags processes with unusually long command lines (>500 chars). Attackers frequently use long command lines for encoded payloads, obfuscated scripts, and base64-encoded commands. Uses eval-based field creation (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Searching/Filtering method with field creation).
queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' | eval cmd_len = length('Command Line') | where cmd_len > 500 | sort -cmd_len | fields 'Process Name', 'Command Line', cmd_len, 'Host Name', User
false_positives: Legitimate PowerShell scripts with many parameters
Deployment tools with long argument lists

queries.title: Windows Process from Unusual Path (Rare Value Analysis)
queries.description: Identifies processes executing from non-standard paths commonly used by attackers (Temp, Public, AppData, Downloads). Legitimate software typically runs from Program Files or System32. Uses rare path analysis (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Sorting/Stacking + Field Analysis).
queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and (('Process Name' like '*Temp*') or ('Process Name' like '*Users*Public*') or ('Process Name' like '*AppData*Local*Temp*') or ('Process Name' like '*Downloads*') or ('Process Name' like '*ProgramData*')) | stats count as executions by 'Process Name', 'Host Name' | sort -executions
false_positives: Temp files created by legitimate updaters

queries.title: Windows Rare Process Detection (Stacking)
queries.description: Identifies rarely-seen processes on Windows endpoints. Uses the rare value hunting technique (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Sorting/Stacking method) to surface processes that appear fewer than 80 times across the active search window, which keeps the demo resilient for a 14-day dataset and repeated reingestion while still highlighting uncommon attacker tooling.
queries.query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and 'Process Name' != '' | stats count as executions by 'Process Name' | sort executions | head 25
